title: Bell establishes new independent sales representation in Morocco
summary: The company has appointed AVIARAIL as a new Bell authorized independent sales representative for its commercial aircraft portfolio.
body_markdown:
Bell Textron Inc. announced during Marrakech Airshow 2026 that it has appointed AVIARAIL as a new Bell authorized independent sales representative for its commercial aircraft portfolio, strengthening its strategic network with new and current Bell operators in Morocco.


“Bell is excited to welcome our new relationship with AVIARAIL,” said Tim Evans, managing director, Middle East and Africa, Bell.


“We believe they deliver the sales expertise required to further Bell’s reach and bring our advanced aircraft solutions to emerging markets.”


AVIARAIL, a Moroccan aerospace and defense company, has built a reputation as a leading sales organization in region. As an authorized Bell independent sales representative, AVIARAIL will promote Bell’s rotary solutions as the premier aircraft of choice throughout the country.


With hundreds of Bell aircraft being used by military and commercial operators across the continent, Bell continues to invest in the African aviation sector through its intricate support network hubs of dedicated independent sales representatives, customer service facilities, and authorized maintenance facilities tailored to providing around-the-clock solutions and support.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Bell.*
